analyst_view.overall: Two struggling sides meet at Craven Cottage. Fulham (15th) are unbeaten in three under Alvaro Arbeloa after starting the season winless in six. Matthias Jaissle's Newcastle (13th) have lost four of their last five, most recently 1-0 at home to Everton. Newcastle are short in midfield: Joelinton is injured, Jacob Ramsey is suspended after a red card against Everton, and Lewis Miley and Matias Fernandez-Pardo are doubts.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals. Newcastle have scored only six in their last six, and Fulham have conceded just four over the same run. Fulham's striker Gonzalo Garcia has not scored in his last eight league starts. With both teams worried about the relegation zone, a cautious, tight game looks more likely than an open one.

corners.text: The numbers say about 11 corners, split fairly evenly. Nothing in the team news clearly moves this figure. Fulham pressing a weakened Newcastle midfield could add a few home corners, but there is no strong reason to move away from the model.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.6 cards. Robert Jones referees a tense game between two sides looking over their shoulders. Newcastle had a man sent off last time out, but they lose Ramsey, one of their combative midfielders, so we stay close to the model.

shots.text: The numbers say about 28 shots. Newcastle's attack has stalled, and a reshuffled midfield without Joelinton and Ramsey should create less. Fulham have recently been more solid than dangerous, so the total could come in a little under the model.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.8 shots on target. Both teams' recent finishing has been poor: Newcastle are well below their expected goals over six games, and Garcia's drought continues. That points to slightly fewer efforts on target than the model expects.
